headline: 回憶錄與音樂劇兩則
context: 紐約時報書評談歐德麗·史馬茲（Audrey Smaltz）的回憶錄《Every Inch a Lady》，讚她故事精彩、卻覺得文字沒能完全捕捉她本人說話的獨特口吻。曼徹斯特皇家交易所劇院則推出音樂劇《Fun Home》，改編自漫畫家艾莉森·貝克德爾（Alison Bechdel）的回憶錄，講她的性覺醒與複雜的家庭關係。

sources.name: The New York Times
sources.summary: In “Every Inch a Lady,” Audrey Smaltz shares her incredible story — if not her inimitable voice.
sources.title: Book Review: ‘Every Inch a Lady,’ by Audrey Smaltz

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: Royal Exchange, Manchester A celebration of the cartoonist’s sexual awakening and queer identity as well as an investigation of darker family dynamics, this soulful show wears its heart on its sleeve The “fun” in the title is short for funeral, a reference to the family undertaking business inherited by Alison Bechdel ’s father. But there is some fun, too, in this heart-filled musical adaptation of the cartoonist’s illustrated memoir. First seen in the UK in 2018 and now revived by director Sarah Frankcom in a fluid in-the-round staging, it brings a light touch to a story freighted with emotion. Published in 2006, the graphic novel describes the author’s sexual awakening – she kissed a girl and she liked it – one that coincided with the discovery of her father’s clandestine gay life. In the musical adaptation by Lisa Kron (book and lyrics) and Jeanine Tesori (music), it becomes a layered reckoning of past and present, as the 43-year-old Bechdel (Jodie McNee) reflects on her student self (Alice Audrey O’Hanlon) reflecting on her childhood self (Felicity Moore at my performance). thread_text:
書評這邊，紐約時報談歐德麗·史馬茲（Audrey Smaltz）的回憶錄《Every Inch a Lady》，說她的故事精彩非凡，可惜文字沒能完全抓住她本人說話那股獨特勁道。劇場那邊，曼徹斯特皇家交易所劇院推出音樂劇《Fun Home》，改編自漫畫家艾莉森·貝克德爾（Alison Bechdel）的回憶錄，講她的性覺醒與複雜的家庭關係，評論說這齣戲把心都掏出來演了。

本則整理自 The New York Times 與 The Guardian 於 2026 年 7 月 12 日發佈的報導。
threads_text:
文化圈兩則，一本書一齣戲。紐約時報書評談歐德麗·史馬茲（Audrey Smaltz）的回憶錄《Every Inch a Lady》——她的人生故事精彩非凡，評論卻覺得文字沒能完全抓住她本人說話那股獨特勁道，算是美中不足。劇場那頭，曼徹斯特的皇家交易所劇院推出音樂劇《Fun Home》，改編自漫畫家艾莉森·貝克德爾（Alison Bechdel）的回憶錄。書名裡的「Fun」其實是「Funeral」的簡稱——她父親經營的是一間殯儀館。這齣戲一邊講她的性覺醒，一邊挖掘更黑暗的家庭關係，評論形容它把心都掏出來演了。

本則整理自 The New York Times 與 The Guardian 於 2026 年 7 月 12 日發佈的報導。
voice_text: 書和戲，各一則。紐約時報書評談歐德麗·史馬茲的回憶錄，說她的人生故事精彩非凡，可惜文字沒能完全抓住她本人說話的那股勁道。劇場這邊，曼徹斯特有一齣音樂劇《Fun Home》，改編自漫畫家艾莉森·貝克德爾的回憶錄——書名裡的「Fun」其實是「殯儀」的簡稱，她父親經營的正是一間殯儀館。這齣戲一邊講她的性覺醒，一邊挖掘更黑暗的家庭關係，評論說它把心都掏出來演了。
